question: For each tenant that has administratively up ports (admin_state_up = 1) bound to at least one security group, list the tenant ID, the total number of such ports, the average number of such ports across all tenants as a benchmark, and categorize the tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'. Only consider ports that also have at least one port security binding. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_ports AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS port_count
  FROM qualifying_ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.tenant_id,
  tc.port_count,
  ab.avg_port_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN tc.port_count >= ab.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
    WHEN tc.port_count <= ab.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
  END AS category
FROM tenant_counts tc
CROSS JOIN avg_benchmark ab

  FROM ports p
